question: Is LokiProxy the same operator as IPPeak (ip-proxy/ippeak-dual-ntt), and should the two records be related?
why: The footer logo image on www.lokiproxy.com carries the alt text IPPeak and the two vendors use the same product menu shape; the vendor pages read name different operators (mingdi Network Technology Research Institute Group Limited for LokiProxy). ip-proxy/ippeak-dual-ntt is outside this unit's scope.
